intent: RollingSummary is the pure-Java value of the one rolling summary per session: summary text, last applied turn id, token count and optimistic version. Null session id or turn id and a negative token count are rejected.

methods.signature: RollingSummary(String sessionId, String summaryText, String lastAppliedTurnId, int tokenCount, long version)
methods.semantics: sessionId and lastAppliedTurnId must be non-null; tokenCount must be >= 0
